subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Surface Area of Solids

outcomes.text: determine the surface area of cones and pyramids from the nets,
calculate the surface area of a sphere and a hemisphere,
determine the surface area of frustums of cones and pyramids,
apply the surfaces area of cones, pyramids and frustums in real life situations,
appreciate the application of surface area of solids.

content: Surface area cone, pyramid (square or rectangular base), sphere, frustum
inquiry_questions: How solids used in real life?
coreCompetencies:
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: the learner uses a cylinder and a cone of the same radius and height to relate volume of a cove to the volume of a cylinder.
Creativity and Imagination: The learner work with peers to model frustums of cones and pyramids both open and closed.
values:
Social Justice: the learner accords equal opportunities when discussing the uses of pyramids and frustums are used
Responsibility: the learner observes safety precautions of others while using locally available materials to model frustums of cones and pyramids.
pcis: Environment and technology: The learner collects and uses locally available materials to model frustums of cones and pyramids for use as a learning resources.
